why: A 2025 Australasian Journal of Combinatorics paper (Alkasasbeh, Dyer, Shalaby, AJC 91(2), pp. 242-265) proves Rosa's conjecture (graceful/near-graceful) for new families of triangular windmills/cacti with three pendant triangles using Skolem sequences, settling a case of the problem while the general conjecture remains open.

found.title: Applying Skolem Sequences to Gracefully Label New Families of Triangular Windmills
found.note: Published paper proving Rosa's conjecture holds for eleven new types of triangular cacti (windmills with three pendant triangles); not read in full.
